summary: The regex engine could enter an infinite loop when matching Unicode regexes with bytes::Regex on invalid UTF-8 input. The bug was in the termination condition of the NFA simulation loops in both the backtracking engine (backtrack.rs) and Pike VM (pikevm.rs). The original code only checked `at.pos() == end` to break the loop, but this could fail to terminate when the input contained invalid UTF-8 sequences that caused the position to not advance normally. The fix adds an additional check `|| at.is_end()` to ensure the loop terminates when the end of input is reached, regardless of position comparisons.
